prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1008; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on the access road near the Fairmont Parkway exit in Pasadena, Texas, when I felt a hard impact from behind. The vehicle behind me did not slow in time and struck the rear of my car. My head snapped back and then forward, and I was jolted against my seatbelt. I got out and spoke with the other driver, who admitted he was looking at his phone. Police arrived and filed a report at the scene. Since the collision I have had stiffness and pain in my neck and lower back, and I have been unable to turn my head fully to check traffic while driving. My doctor has diagnosed a neck and back strain and recommended physical therapy. My car has visible damage to the rear bumper and trunk, and I have attached photographs taken at the scene.
